what: The list automatically picks the next row every eight beats (the picked row’s content enters the side panel in one beat), and pressing a row goes to that row and restarts the timer from the beginning. The playhead on the panel passes once every 16 beats. Pauses when off screen

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
options.every: Advance every how many beats, default 8
options.dur: Time (s) for panel content to come in, default one beat
options.y: Distance (px) the panel content floats up, default 0 (it only blurs, then sharpens)
options.out: Time in seconds to fade the previous content first, default 0 (swapped immediately) — so the new one enters after the old one leaves, like the original Framer AnimatePresence mode wait
options.pick: With hover, hovering a row also picks that row, and it does not advance by itself while the hand is over a row (original Brand) — default is pick on press only
